verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own site documents token customization with groups and icons, which covers the folder/group and service-icon parts of the story. That support rests on a single marketing line with no corroboration, and search is never mentioned. Missing for 10: documented search/filter across tokens, evidence of quick two-tap access to the right code, in-depth docs on group management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
